summary: Layer 1B expands the universe for utility-qualified transmission-line hardware. The strongest pure-play underfollowed candidate is PLPC, whose filings directly describe energy products used to support, protect, terminate, splice, and damp transmission and distribution lines. HUBB is a higher-attention reference leader with direct connectors, insulators, arresters, and transmission hardware exposure. VMI and AZZ are adjacent second-order beneficiaries: VMI through transmission and distribution structures, and AZZ through galvanizing/corrosion protection for T&D steel structures and components. The chokepoint hypothesis remains that small but mandatory field-proven hardware and adjacent durability services can become sticky because utility specifications, reliability requirements, and requalification cycles slow supplier switching.
